  - Component granularity (at least: Streaming vs API Gateway vs Serving/Capacity & Routing; plus Dedicated control plane if relevant).

- Security/compliance:
  - SSO/SAML + SCIM (already enabled);
  - audit logs for admin actions + incident comms artifacts;
  - retention controls for prompts/outputs (policy-driven) and KMS-backed encryption.
